authorization: Pending owner review (2026-10-27). Planning only: nothing is live or verified. The owner asked for this change in the words "Work on delete check fix. If we need to delete a shared check we need to unshared and then delete". Each production apply still needs its own owner approval, a staging acceptance reference and a read-only production inspect that confirms the live bytes.
notes: Delete Check (workflow.mjs handleDeleteCheck, the handler production serves): it refused every check whose external_origin names a source check or Freedom CRM as shared with a partner, so a partner-ingested copy with no share could not be deleted, and it refused a check in Review that had a claim_payments row (written when OCR links a claim) or a check_billing_events row (the mortgage_handling event written when a check enters Review). Now only an active shared_checks row (revoked_at IS NULL) refuses, with 'Unshare it first, then delete it'; claim_payments is not a blocker (its check link is ON DELETE SET NULL); check_billing_events blocks only when not voided and invoiced (status or invoice_id) or not mortgage_handling. Deposits, Check Alt deposits, disbursements, payment directions, deposited claim checks and terminal checks still refuse. The plan row keeps expected_live_sha256; a read-only production overlay inspect must confirm the live bytes before any apply.
